scope: whole project (next-app-router fixture: app/, data/, package.json, tsconfig.json)

findings.title: Server-only payment secret read in a client component
findings.explanation: Checkout.tsx is a "use client" module and reads process.env.PAYMENT_SECRET_KEY (no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix) to build a Bearer token. Non-prefixed env vars are undefined in the browser, so the request is sent with 'Bearer undefined' and the payment call fails. Charging from the browser with a secret key is also wrong by design. No secret value is hard-coded and Checkout is not currently imported anywhere in the fixture, so this is rated high rather than critical.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the charge call into a Server Action or Route Handler that reads PAYMENT_SECRET_KEY on the server; have the client component call that and keep only the button/status UI client-side.

findings.title: Large hero image uses plain instead of next/image
findings.explanation: The filename indicates a 4000x2500 source, and Hero is the first element rendered in the home page, so it is likely above the fold. A plain gets no automatic resizing, modern formats or priority loading, which hurts LCP, and has no width/height so it can cause layout shift. Assumption: the file is actually that large, based on its name. No eslint-disable is visible, and no ESLint config exists in the fixture.
findings.suggested_fix: Use next/image: <Image src="/hero-4000x2500.jpg" alt="Mountains at sunrise" width={1200} height={750} priority sizes="100vw" />.

findings.title: Page marked "use client" without using any client-only feature
findings.explanation: The page uses no state, effects, handlers or browser APIs; it only renders Hero and maps a static array. The directive turns the whole page into a client component, shipping its JS to the browser and preventing it from fetching data on the server later. Impact is small today because the data is a static import, hence low.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the "use client" directive so the page stays a Server Component; add the directive only to interactive leaf components such as Checkout.

limitations: Static read of the 7 project files only; nothing was run, built or linted.
No ESLint config or next.config.* exists in the fixture, so lint suppressions and image domain settings could not be checked.
The size of /hero-4000x2500.jpg and whether Hero renders above the fold are inferred from its filename and position, since the public/ asset is not present.
